result.summary: The page is largely well-designed, but the 'Fastest near you' carousel shows two identical 'Green Bowl Poké' cards with the same image and delivery fee, which looks like duplicated/placeholder data. The third card ('Smash Bros Bu...') is cut off at the right edge without a clear scroll affordance, and the horizontal category chips are also clipped. These are minor-to-moderate visual/content issues.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' row displays two identical 'Green Bowl Poké' cards with the same image, same '15–25 min' badge, and same '€0.90 delivery' text, making it look like duplicated or placeholder data rather than distinct restaurants.
issues.suggestion: Populate the carousel with distinct restaurant entries (unique names, images, and delivery info), or deduplicate if the same restaurant is being listed twice.

issues.description: The third card in 'Fastest near you' ('Smash Bros Bu...') is clipped at the right viewport edge with the title truncated and no visible scroll indicator, which can make the horizontal scrollability unclear.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle scroll affordance (e.g., peeking card edge already present is good, but consider a fade/gradient or scroll dots) and ensure truncated titles use an ellipsis consistently.

issues.description: The category filter chips row ('All', 'Pizza', 'Sushi', 'Burgers', 'Healthy') is cut off on the right with a partially visible chip, without a clear visual cue that more categories exist.
issues.suggestion: Add a right-edge fade gradient or chevron to signal horizontal scrolling of the chip list.
